description.text: Premium Trainer Box ex, released on 20 January 2023 with the Scarlet ex and Violet ex expansions that began the Scarlet & Violet series: ten packs of each and 196 cards of 36 kinds for building decks, 60 cards of 28 kinds and 17 of each of the eight basic Energy. Strong Sword & Shield cards, Serena and Lumineon V among them, sit beside Scarlet & Violet ones, with two each of Mew, Gutsy Pickaxe, Path to the Peak, Irida and Serena and one Lumineon V. A card box, a coin, acrylic damage counters, premium Poison and Burn markers and a metal damage counter case came with it. This set holds the 28 kinds.
